finalText:
**The build passes now.** You were right, two warnings were real bugs.

1. The bundler renamed one setting. `src/core/options.js` still read the old name `retries`. It now reads `retryCount`, and falls back to the old one.
2. Unset flags now come back as `undefined`. `src/net/retryPolicy.js` threw on that. Unset now means off.

The other 8 warnings are just old-API notices. Harmless.
